meta.title: Halden — Cold-climate skincare, made of very little
meta.description: Halden is a Nordic skincare line built on three formulas, twelve ingredients and nothing else. Barrier Serum, Glacier Cream, Birch Cleansing Oil.

brand.name: Halden
brand.tagline: Cold climate · short ingredient lists · nothing you cannot pronounce
brand.disclosure: Halden is a concept brand created for design purposes.

hero.support: Cold climate · short ingredient lists · nothing you cannot pronounce

intro.heading: LESS. BUT *BETTER.*
intro.body: Most shelves are full of things doing very little in large quantities. Halden runs the other way: three formulas, twelve ingredients between them, each one at a dose that actually does the work. Nothing added to make the label longer.

product.alt: Halden Barrier Serum turning through the light

cards.label: 01 — THE COMMUTE
cards.headline: MINUS ELEVEN, STILL DARK
cards.body: Cold outside, forced air inside, and eight hours between the two. The barrier takes the whole of it.

cards.label: 02 — THE LONG WINTER
cards.headline: MONTH FOUR OF SIX
cards.body: By February the usual routine has stopped working. This is the point Halden was formulated for.

cards.label: 03 — THE THAW
cards.headline: LIGHT COMES BACK
cards.body: Skin recovers faster than people expect, given the right three things and none of the rest.

range.heading: THREE STEPS, *NO MORE*
range.body: Cleanse, repair, protect. Everything else on a bathroom shelf is either one of these three wearing a different label, or nothing at all.

products.name: Barrier Serum
products.subtitle: Niacinamide at 5%, panthenol, oat lipids. Repairs what winter takes.

products.name: Glacier Cream
products.subtitle: Squalane and shea, whipped light. Holds moisture through dry indoor air.

products.name: Birch Cleansing Oil
products.subtitle: Birch sap and sunflower oil. Lifts the day off without stripping anything.

ingredients.heading: TWELVE THINGS, *COUNTED*
ingredients.body: Every ingredient is listed at its real percentage on the carton. If something is in there at a level too low to work, it is not in there.

cards.title: Cold-Pressed Lipids
cards.body: Oat and sunflower lipids pressed without heat, so the fatty acids that rebuild the barrier arrive intact.

cards.title: Named Actives
cards.body: Niacinamide at 5%, panthenol at 3%. Printed on the box, because a percentage you cannot see is a claim, not a dose.

cards.title: Nothing Decorative
cards.body: No fragrance, no colourant, no botanical added at 0.01% for the ingredient list. Twelve ingredients, all of them working.

items.title: Cleanse
items.body: Birch oil onto dry skin, warm water to lift it off. Once at night is enough, twice is too much.

items.title: Repair
items.body: Four drops of Barrier Serum on damp skin, pressed rather than rubbed. Give it thirty seconds.

items.title: Protect
items.body: Glacier Cream over the top, more of it in the coldest months. That is the entire routine.

story.heading: MADE FOR *THE DARK HALF*
paragraphs: Halden began in a town where the sun clears the roofline for about four hours in December, and every skincare routine anybody owned quietly stopped working around the middle of January.
So we cut the shelf down to what survives a real winter: three formulas, twelve ingredients, doses printed on the box. Everything that was there for the marketing came out.

faq.heading: YOUR *QUESTIONS*
faq.intro: The things people ask before the first order, answered without the marketing voice.

items.q: Will this work on sensitive skin?
items.a: It was formulated for it. No fragrance, no essential oils, no denatured alcohol. If your skin reacts to most things, this is the shorter list.
No. The Barrier Serum does the most work and stands on its own. The other two make it last longer through a hard winter.

items.q: Why are the percentages on the box?
items.a: Because an active at an unstated dose tells you nothing. Ours are printed where you can read them before you buy.
The glass, the aluminium lids and the cartons all are. The pumps are the one part that is not yet, and we are working on it.

find.heading: FIND HALDEN *NEAR YOU.*
find.body: Stocked in independent pharmacies and skin studios across the Nordics, with more each season. Tell us where you are and we will point you at the nearest.

footer.statement: Three formulas, twelve ingredients, doses printed on the box. Built for six months of wind off the water.
footer.responsible: For external use only. Patch test if your skin is reactive.
